shared_rules.alternative_policies: No ranking, mandatory sequence, blending or motor-weight sharing. Each independently learns the same instance-to-placement responsibility from the same two episodes.
shared_rules.actual_actuation: Disabled: no hardware I/O. An enabled decoder result is only a command-format artifact relying on externally verified controller/safety attestations.
shared_rules.goal_preservation: Save the fixed rendered foreground in the original undistorted third chart before cancellation. Refresh automatic inventory and confirm the same physical referent. reexpress_goal(new_template, old_foreground) computes a new template-relative clockwise angle for the same intended absolute center/silhouette; refuse poor similarity/scale/IoU rather than silently change the objective. Semantic symmetry is an HLA judgment. Refresh protected-instance references.
shared_rules.identity_refresh: Required at every new motor invocation, after persistent ambiguity/occlusion, policy switch, scene/chart change or stale template. observe_scene supplies automatic material proposals, not character recognition. Never resolve ambiguity from demonstration order.
shared_rules.nontransferable_memory: Motor graph/RGB histories, gated neural state, response-head state, previous candidate outputs and learned normalization are policy-local. Start act with memory=None and the destination model's own checkpoint/spec. Only separately maintained causal scene identity may persist with refreshed uncertainty.
shared_rules.status_scope: goal_observed means sustained image foreground/centroid/rotation-modulo-symmetry agreement, not success, contact release, tool clearance, readability or successor readiness. successor_ready is always false. All non-running statuses request an external verified stop.
shared_rules.perception_adaptation: No downloaded assets. Broad brown-material connected components on light support and causal appearance/area/motion assignment replace the assumed generic learned segmentation/flow model. Novel silhouette proposal is possible under this material assumption; generic perception and open-alphabet recognition are not claimed.
shared_rules.evaluation_scope: No preliminary semantic/performance study; fixed independent 20,000-update seed-0 training. Training loss is not robot success. Held-out physical shapes, identities, materials, words/repeats, arrangements/layouts and joint novelty need independent evaluation.

responsibility.scope: One selected physical instance to one fixed explicit image placement, including observed approach, pushing, re-contact, corrections, staging and withdrawal.
responsibility.family: Independent boundary-message-passing plus causal gated-memory Gaussian-mixture neural policy.
responsibility.not_responsible: Letter recognition, multiset allocation, goal/order selection, collision-free high-level planning, successor choice, stop execution or word success.

observable_and_returned: current RGB/foreground continuity available for HLA inspection
selection_cues.implemented_checks: Candidate gate requires observed selected identity confidence >=0.65; geometry is not reconstructed from future masks. Projection validity is returned, not asserted visually verified. No true contour-completeness/contact classifier exists.
selection_cues.hla_judgment: Consider when visible outer/inner boundaries and actual instance association are reliable, especially to test shape-conditioned transfer. Tool geometry, reachability, safe travel and completeness require external commissioning/inspection. This is a selection hypothesis, not a measured advantage.

entry_conditions.candidate_scope: No controller contract is required merely to compute a learned candidate. It is required by decode_action before an enabled command artifact.

continuation_conditions.available_monitors: Foreground/centroid/rotation discrepancy, two-second trend, direction changes, possible neighbor shifts and mixture spread; no neural done bit or known contact state.
continuation_conditions.hla_judgment: Assess lack of progress, suspicious geometry, force-residual anomalies, safety and identity. Plateau/direction changes are not automatically diagnosed as contact loss or a need to switch. Do not continue issuing old candidates on a null-action status.

exit_conditions.code: goal_observed after caller-duration agreement in center, foreground IoU and symmetry-aware angle; timeout; cancel; unavailable/uncertain/blocked reasons. Goal, timeout, cancel and observation-gap exits terminate. Other uncertainty/blocked states may be re-observed while externally stopped under the same call.
exit_conditions.not_success: All exits are advisories; geometric agreement or episode endpoint is not safe release, word success or validated manipulation success.
exit_conditions.hla_action: Arrange a verified external stop on non-running status, then decide re-observation, cancellation, goal revision or alternative invocation.

successor_readiness.returned: successor_ready=false, scene_version, observed track/goal residuals and possible neighbor shifts; tool_clearance_estimate=null and contact_state=null.
successor_readiness.implemented: No automatic next-instance selection and no clearance-qualified success claim.
hla_required: confirm robot is safely stopped and tool can clear/travel safely
refresh all affected placements and identities
check requested layout readability and stability independently
decide successor physical instance, spatial goal and policy

steps: Stop/cancel old invocation through externally verified control.
Save intended fixed image foreground, not a candidate or a demonstration endpoint.
Refresh automatic scene inventory and HLA physical referent association; refresh protected refs.

Use reexpress_goal(new_template, old_fixed_foreground); accept only goal_reexpressed and HLA-resolved semantic symmetry. Unsupported scale/shape/perspective needs recalibration/re-planning, not silent retargeting.
Create new call_id with re-expressed goal and the new template; invoke chosen trained model with memory=None and its own spec.
switch_procedure.potential_alternative: visual_push may be considered when contour proxy deteriorates yet current physical identity remains uniquely observed in RGB. This is not a trained recovery guarantee or automatic cascade.
switch_procedure.do_not_transfer: Graph hidden/motor history, response state, old candidate outputs or normalizers. Relative angle must not simply be copied after the physical piece/template has rotated.

implemented_or_returned: goal outside supported chart/workspace or conflicting with supplied protected foreground
observable_but_hla_interpreted: TCP image projection disagrees with actual rod
tool moves without visible piece progress
failure_signatures.not_inferred: No measured contact/clearance/force ground truth, singularity diagnosis, friction estimate or successful recovery classification.

memory_reset_rules.reset: New instance, placement, template, scene/chart, policy, controls/tolerances or terminated call requires new call_id and memory=None. Signature mismatches refuse rather than transferring hidden state.
memory_reset_rules.continue: Changing current observation, contact side or uncertainty for the SAME fixed call may update causal tracking/history, but uncertain status returns no command.
memory_reset_rules.training: Eight samples at stride three; padding/masks within each original segment only, no cross-cut hidden state or future fill.
memory_reset_rules.scene_tracker: Separate perception inventory memory may persist only with valid causal association; refresh at new invocation, switch or ambiguity.

raw: paired original third and wrist uint8 RGB
robot t, sample index, image timestamps/ages
observation_dependencies.derived: Half-resolution causal material foreground/association, current/goal contours with holes, neighbors/image-boundary roles, unverified projected TCP point, measured state/missing flags and short causal graph history.
observation_dependencies.assets: No downloaded weights, table homography, robot/rod silhouette, depth reconstruction, alphabet recognizer or segmentation labels assumed. Contour motor path does not encode wrist RGB, but shared conversion and wrist-pose features require its camera/state contract.

training_evidence.ranges: Exact original [start,stop) intervals are in source_segments; anchor=stop-1, all original 30-row handoff exclusion bands unchanged.
training_evidence.demonstration_support: W blocks: elevated approach. A/B W,O,L: transport, boundary changes and re-contact. A-L/A-D-align/A-I-align/B-R/B-D-align: pose corrections. A-D-stage/B-D-stage: inner-hole evidence at A4800/B1800. Staging and later revisit blocks: distinct local achieved placements. B-R retains 4050-4200 posture/re-contact under one goal.
training_evidence.filtering: Both policies receive the SAME common eligible cache. Per-segment coverage records missing commands, edge/range exclusions, state/perception failures and goal-registration failure. Assigned motion support is not a claim all failed-perception rows trained.
training_evidence.not_demonstrated: Verified recovery strategy, unseen-shape/friction competence, general collision avoidance, semantic word success or calibration of safety/progress thresholds.

limitations: Material-limited perception may merge/swap/fragment unknown pieces; color novelty is not solved.
Contours are not mass/friction/contact/clearance, and inner holes can jam an unfamiliar tool/piece.
Similarity image goals and two-pixel foreground raster are not metric/projective precision.
Two episodes do not establish unseen physical-shape/letter/word/layout generalization.
No arbitrary homing, grasping, falls/flips/stacks or large-collision recovery.
Common perception/controller errors mean the two alternatives are not independent safety redundancy.

responsibility.scope: One caller-selected physical piece to one fixed explicit image placement; demonstrated approach, contact changes, transport, alignment, staging and withdrawal remain internal learned choices.
responsibility.family: Independent marked third global/detail, wrist and goal encoders plus causal gated-memory Gaussian-mixture neural policy.
responsibility.not_responsible: Character/word interpretation, next-instance/goal selection, task sequencing, safe stop execution, general recovery or certified success.

observable_and_returned: third and wrist RGB and original signed image ages
causal error trend and direction changes
selection_cues.implemented_checks: Observed selected association/area confidence >=0.3, required fresh dual-view images and finite state. Missing identity never becomes a fictional predicted complete mask. No calibrated cross-view consistency or visual semantic recognizer is implemented.
selection_cues.hla_judgment: Consider when partial boundaries remain uniquely associated and current RGB/wrist response is informative. Any advantage over contours under occlusion is an untested hypothesis, not evidence of broader recovery or blindness tolerance.

continuation_conditions.available_monitors: Target-marker confidence, foreground/centroid/symmetry residuals, recent trend, possible neighbor displacement and mixture spread. Neural memory is never a substitute for mandatory current observations.
continuation_conditions.hla_judgment: Inspect marker drift/identity, suspicious view disagreement, no-progress/oscillation and actual tool/scene safety. Current code exposes but does not classify these as contact loss, friction or recovery phase.

exit_conditions.code: Shared causal geometric agreement window can return goal_observed; cancel/timeout/gap terminate. Unavailable/uncertain/blocked returns no command and requests verified external stop. No learned success bit or demonstration-order successor exists.
exit_conditions.not_success: Image agreement alone does not prove clearance, safe handoff, semantic word correctness or final stability of all objects.
exit_conditions.hla_action: Stop externally, re-observe and choose re-planning/reassociation/switching only after safety and identity review.

successor_readiness.returned: successor_ready=false with scene version, current geometry/track residuals and possible neighbor shifts. Clearance/contact/view-consistency are unavailable, not inferred from recurrence.
successor_readiness.implemented: No automatic successor, no unsafe persistent command when identity is absent, and no geometric-goal-to-safety equivalence.
hla_required: verify safe stop and actual tool clearance/travel
refresh affected scene identities and protected placements
choose next instance/goal/policy rather than follow recording order
validate current backend and hazard context

steps: Stop/cancel using verified external control and preserve old fixed goal foreground in the calibrated chart.
Refresh automatic inventory; HLA confirms the same physical referent, semantic symmetry and protected references.
Use reexpress_goal against the new template to preserve intended absolute placement; reject poor shape/scale/IoU or unsupported perspective instead of copying a stale relative angle.
Create a new invocation and use the chosen model's own checkpoint/spec with memory=None.
switch_procedure.potential_alternative: contour_push can be considered if reliable boundary geometry and association are restored; selection is not a mandatory sequence or empirically validated ranking.
switch_procedure.do_not_transfer: Visual feature window, gated motor state, response state, candidate outputs, learned normalizers or imagined contact state. Only separately refreshed causal perception identity may persist.

observable_but_hla_interpreted: large action dispersion or unstable scene appearance
failure_signatures.not_inferred: No automatic calibrated view-consistency score, semantic recognizer, contact/clearance/force measurement or reliable hidden-state confidence under full occlusion.

memory_reset_rules.reset: Any instance/goal/template/chart/scene/policy/control/tolerance change or terminated call requires a new invocation and memory=None.
memory_reset_rules.continue: Only changing current observations/contact side for the SAME fixed goal continues causal memory. Under uncertainty, no old action is repeated by this package.
memory_reset_rules.training: Eight causal samples at stride three, within original segment and masks, with nonlatest dropout; no prior-segment warmup or future images.
memory_reset_rules.scene_tracker: Keep separate from motor memory. Refresh association after switches, stale templates and persistent uncertainty; no semantic identity inferred from track numbering.

raw: original paired third and wrist RGB uint8
robot t/sample index and original image timestamps/ages
observation_dependencies.derived: Causal selected marker, 320x180 global RGB/marker, 160x160 target/tool detail with crop mapping, 256x144 wrist RGB, 160x90 masked goal foreground/RGB, 142 state/missing channels and eight masked history positions.
observation_dependencies.assets: No pretrained visual weights, generic segmentation/flow or alphabet recognizer. No metric plane, depth or verified rod silhouette. Projected TCP is unverified point geometry only.

training_evidence.ranges: Exact source_segments above; all cuts, stop-1 anchors, masks and original handoff exclusions unchanged.
training_evidence.demonstration_support: W blocks include elevated approach; A/B W,O,L show transport and repeated contacts; A4800/B1800 show inner-hole near-contact appearance. B-R 3900/4050/4200 motivates causal interpretation of contact/posture changes, not a separate proven recovery skill. Staging/revisit blocks preserve distinct local goals; alignment blocks include corrections and withdrawal.
training_evidence.filtering: Exactly the same eligible common dataset as contour_push. Coverage records disclose automatic anchor/state/command/perception failures; no statement that a failed derived row was trained.
training_evidence.not_demonstrated: Held-out-shape/color/friction transfer, robust occlusion recovery, semantic word success, safe collision recovery, policy-selection benefit or calibrated uncertainty.

limitations: Appearance can overfit familiar brown pieces, stickers, camera, tabletop and visible arrangements.
Both views share an unprovided generic-perception gap, replaced by material-specific components; full identity loss cannot be repaired by recurrence.
Reduced practical resolutions/history and full-chart low-resolution goal appearance may lose fine edge/tool detail.
No metric/projective goal renderer or true contact/clearance/view-consistency signal.
Two episodes do not establish unseen physical letters, new words/layouts or recovery from stacks/falls/flips.
No performance ranking, safety redundancy or general-purpose homing/planning claim; no actuation.
